# Siemens Image Viewer/Importer

**Author:** DreameR; CRC calculator — DarkBear<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![Siemens Image Viewer/Importer: screenshot 1](./siemens-cms35-ie/img/siemens-cms35-ie.png)

</div>

The program opens Siemens x35 FullFlash files, displays embedded images, and lets you replace them. Skin import and export are supported; a CRC calculator is built in for data verification.

## Versions

- **2.3 alpha** — [siemens-cms35-ie-2.3-alpha.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/modding/siemens-cms35-ie/files/siemens-cms35-ie-2.3-alpha.zip)<br/>Windows 32-bit · 249 KiB
